text: ひとあせ　かいて　そろそろ　マジで　やせるかあ！

patterns.name: 〜か (talking to oneself)
patterns.explanation: か here is not a real question; the speaker is saying to himself 'right, let's do this'. やせるかあ = 'time to slim down!'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. ひとあせ　かいて = 'work up a sweat and...'.
